title: Continuity in s and mass bounds for a finite-mass current evaluated on dt-slices and horizontal slices (supplied step 3)
statement: (D1) For all m, k ∈ ℕ, every X ∈ D_k(ℝ^m) with M(X) < ∞, every η ∈ D^{k+1}(ℝ^{m+1}) and every φ : ℝ → D^k(ℝ^m) with φ(s)(x)(v) = η(cons(s,x))(Fin.cons e₀ (fun i => ι(v i))) for all s ∈ [0,1], x ∈ ℝ^m, v : Fin k → ℝ^m: s ↦ X(φ(s)) is continuous on [0,1], and for every C ∈ ℝ with |η(y)| ≤ C for all y, |X(φ(s))| ≤ M(X).toReal·C for all s ∈ [0,1]. (D2) For all m, q ∈ ℕ, every X ∈ D_q(ℝ^m) with M(X) < ∞, every continuous compactly supported ω : ℝ^{m+1} → (q-covectors on ℝ^{m+1}) and every Ψ : ℝ → D^q(ℝ^m) with Ψ(s)(x)(v) = ω(cons(s,x))(fun i => ι(v i)) for all s, x, v: s ↦ X(Ψ(s)) is continuous on ℝ, and for every C with |ω(y)| ≤ C for all y, |X(Ψ(s))| ≤ M(X).toReal·C for all s. Here |·| = covectorEuclideanNorm, cons(s,x) := (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m+1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x)), ι(w) := cons(0, w), e₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1, D^q = TestFormOn univ q, D_q = GeometricCurrentOn univ q, M = mass.
lean_statement: (∀ (m k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) k), X.mass < ∞ → ∀ (η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (k + 1)) (φ : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) k), (∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ (x : Eucl m) (v : Fin k → Eucl m), (φ s : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) k) x v = (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (k + 1)) ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ (v i))))) → ContinuousOn (fun s => X (φ s)) (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧ ∀ C : ℝ, (∀ y, covectorEuclideanNorm ((η : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (k + 1)) y) ≤ C) → ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, |X (φ s)| ≤ X.mass.toReal * C) ∧ (∀ (m q : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) q), X.mass < ∞ → ∀ (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) q) (Ψ : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) q), Continuous ω → HasCompactSupport ω → (∀ (s : ℝ) (x : Eucl m) (v : Fin q → Eucl m), (Ψ s : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) q) x v = ω ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x))) (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ (v i))))) → Continuous (fun s => X (Ψ s)) ∧ ∀ C : ℝ, (∀ y, covectorEuclideanNorm (ω y) ≤ C) → ∀ s : ℝ, |X (Ψ s)| ≤ X.mass.toReal * C)
